steps.en: The request status becomes Pending automatically
steps.id: Status request berubah jadi Pending secara otomatis

steps.en: The Pending status is copied to the public side
steps.id: Status Pending disalin juga ke sisi publik

steps.en: Staff can browse the list of pending requests
steps.id: Staff bisa melihat daftar request yang pending

steps.en: The pending status shows the officer's user ID
steps.id: Status pending tampil bersama user ID officer
steps.why_en: Only a technical system account is recorded; no officer user ID is attached to Pending.
steps.why_id: Yang tercatat hanya akun sistem teknis; tidak ada user ID officer pada status Pending.
